- Episode 10: "A New World, Part One" - May 3, 2023

There will be no new episodes of "The Flash" because:
1. Season 9 was announced as the final season in August 2022
2. The show was officially canceled and will not have a Season 10
3. The series has completely concluded

If you're looking to watch the show, all episodes are available on The CW app and Netflix (in the US, the full final season arrived about a week after the finale).
